title: Countertop Soap Dispenser 5-Ounce Solid Brass | Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom vanity with a space-saving soap dispenser that keeps soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer close at hand with a generous 5 ounce bottle.

  • Coordinated look: Designed to pair with the Waverly Place collection for a pulled-together sink area.
  • Solid brass construction: Crafted from brass for enduring daily use.
  • Multi-use: Ideal as a soap dispenser, lotion dispenser, or hand sanitizer dispenser.
  • Space-saving design: Efficient countertop placement helps keep your vanity organized.
  • Finish options: Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes to complement transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Specs

  • Collection: Waverly Place
  • Mounting type: Countertop
  • Material: Brass
  • Capacity: 5 ounce bottle
  • Overall size: 3 in L x 5 in W x 7 in H
  • Projection: 4 in
  • Product weight: 2.4 lb
  • Weight capacity: 5 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Soap dispenser
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
